publicationApprovalBasis: 4 separate Wikimedia Commons File pages explicitly state uploader MarcelX42, Own work and author self-issued CC BY-SA 4.0. All four real 480px hash-derived JPEGs decoded and visually inspected. Two exact T25 and two exact T115 images are the same named physical global model as the official TYM global alias; actual event photographed 2025, not current brochure or 2026 model year. All derivatives were produced with strict origin SHA and Pillow, and only international published Supabase UUIDs are eligible. A photo does not certify a precise drivetrain, tire, loader, gearbox or market trim. Source deduplication: four originally reviewed source files include two photographs already released under historical IDs. Only two new rear-angle JPEG sets (six derivative files) are newly released; the two existing fronts are reused with stronger UUID-scoped rights metadata.
